```{r}
# short block to check if the packages are installed; will download and install any that are not.4
# ex: c("lpsolveapi", "mlbench")

packages <- c()

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
```
